caption:
7 copy-paste prompts that turn ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini into your personal language tutor 🗣️

Swap [LANGUAGE] for the one you're learning and start today.

Save this pack for your next study session.

slides.title: prompts to learn any language with AI
slides.sub: Your private tutor, conversation partner and grammar coach in one chat.
slides.voiceover: Seven prompts that turn your AI chat into a private language tutor.

slides.name: The private tutor
slides.sub: Start from zero, one lesson at a time.
slides.prompt: You are my private [LANGUAGE] tutor and I'm a complete beginner. Build a learning path for me, then teach it one short lesson at a time: a simple explanation, real-life examples, pronunciation tips and a mini exercise. Only continue when I pass the exercise.

lines: Mini exercise: introduce yourself in 2 sentences

slides.voiceover: One. The private tutor. It teaches one short lesson at a time.

slides.name: The 90-day plan
slides.sub: A daily schedule that fits the time you really have.
slides.prompt: Make a 90-day plan for learning [LANGUAGE] with [MINUTES] minutes a day. Give each day a focus: vocabulary, grammar, listening, speaking, reading, writing or review. Add a weekly goal and a quick self-test so I can see my progress.
slides.tip: Paste the plan back each day and ask: "Today is day [N]. Teach it."
slides.voiceover: Two. A ninety day plan built around the minutes you actually have.

slides.name: The conversation partner
slides.sub: Speak from day one, with gentle corrections.
slides.prompt: Be my [LANGUAGE] conversation partner. Start at beginner level and make it harder as I improve. After each of my replies, correct my mistakes, explain why in one line, show how a native speaker would say it, then keep the conversation going.

lines: So, what do you do for work?

slides.voiceover: Three. A conversation partner that corrects every mistake, then keeps talking.

slides.name: The vocabulary builder
slides.sub: The words you'll actually use, first.
slides.prompt: Teach me the 20 most useful [LANGUAGE] words and phrases for [SITUATION], like ordering food or asking for directions. For each one: meaning, an example sentence and a memory trick. End with a 5-question quiz.
slides.tip: Ask for the list as a table, then turn it into flashcards.
slides.voiceover: Four. Learn the words for real situations first, with memory tricks.

slides.name: The grammar simplifier
slides.sub: One rule at a time, compared with your language.
slides.prompt: Explain [LANGUAGE] grammar to me one rule at a time, in plain words, with 3 everyday examples. Compare each rule with [MY NATIVE LANGUAGE] when it helps. Then give me 3 exercises and explain every mistake I make.
slides.voiceover: Five. Grammar one rule at a time, compared with your own language.

slides.name: The immersion trip
slides.sub: Live the language without a plane ticket.
slides.prompt: Simulate a day in [CITY] in [LANGUAGE]: a café, a shop, a train station. Play every person I meet, ask me questions, bring in new words naturally and use less of my native language as I get better.

lines: Barista: Good morning! What can I get you?

slides.voiceover: Six. A full day of role play in a city, without the flight.

slides.name: The weekly check-up
slides.sub: Find your weak spots before they stick.
slides.prompt: Test my [LANGUAGE] level with 10 mixed questions: vocabulary, grammar, reading and a short writing task. Grade my answers, tell me my 3 weakest areas and give me a study plan for next week.
slides.voiceover: Seven. A weekly test that finds your weak spots and plans the next week.

slides.title: Make them work even better
items: Language, level, minutes, city: the more specific, the better the lessons.
The AI remembers your progress inside the conversation.
Use your app's voice mode to practice speaking and listening.
slides.voiceover: Fill in every bracket, keep one chat per language, and say it out loud.
